note: Lebanon, read on the General Directorate of General Security's own page (rendered in a browser, its text being drawn by script) on 2026-10-30. Foreign artists who don't work in nightclubs may obtain temporary residency six months at a time, on a valid employment contract for the residence's length and the fees (doubled for the service), which the page doesn't give; the residency is granted in Lebanon and read as tied to the contract. The annual residence, permanent residence and fee pages are drawn the same way and weren't read in full, so no other route is written; nightclub artists' entry has its own rules, not modelled.

sources.title: General Directorate of General Security, Residency of foreign artists
sources.said: Foreign artists, who do not work in Nightclubs, can obtain temporary residency for a period of six months at once, on the condition that: • Possession of a valid employment contract for the duration of residence. • Payment of the fees in accordance with the rules. • Payment of double fees for the service.
